question_stem:
A wire has length L and cross-sectional area A. The wire is made from a metal that has Young
modulus E and resistivity ρ.

A wire has length L and cross-sectional area A. The wire is made from a metal that has Young
modulus E and resistivity $\rho$.

parts.question_text:

parts.question_text:
